- `hunram` is threaded as a **hypothesis** all the way down — through c2b's `hvanish_involution` ([ShapiroDeepness.lean:187](GQ2/ShapiroDeepness.lean:187)) into `SectionSix.lemma_6_16` and `HilbertLedger.cup_unramified_unit` — never proved. c2c is the ticket that finally discharges it.

  Nicely, these are **axiom-free** (the B13 filtration is an argument, so B13 enters only at the call site).

**What remains — half (B), the leaf decision (needs your/f2-lead sign-off):** derive `‖π_L‖ = ‖π_k‖` from `ρ(ĝ) ∉ inertia`. Because `inertia` is undefined and the tame-tower↔absolute-Galois bridge is nontrivial, the honest options are **(B-axiom)** a small Serre-cited "unramified ⟹ equal value group" leaf in norm vocabulary (a B13-neighbour — cheapest, in-keeping) or **(B-derive)** define inertia analytically and prove the bridge (a real build). **Gates:** `lean_verify card_unitImage_eq_e` = **std-3 exactly** — beating the budgeted "std-3 + B5", since the statement is parametric in `R : LocalReciprocity` (B5 enters only at c2c4's instantiation). `lake build` green, 8731 jobs. **The decisive survey findings** (all verified against source this session):

- `QZero = iotaB ∘ graphPullback` where `iotaB` is just the **continuous-coboundary indicator** ([PhaseObstruction.lean:51](../gq2-lean/GQ2/PhaseObstruction.lean:51)) — and every layer of the local composition except the pinned value is **source-generic**: `gaussZ_reduction` (now σ-free), the `Z¹⧸B¹ ≅ H¹` bridge (checked: generic-Γ section), the finiteness trick via e6's `hZcard_gammaA`. - The evaluation device exists in the repo: `H²(Γ_A,𝔽₂) ↪ 𝔽₂` via **relator evaluation** (`WordCoh2.card_H2_gammaA_le_two` + the e5 marking calculus), which turns `Q̄⁰` into an explicit 𝔽₂-quadratic in e6's generator coordinates.
- The finale needs **no new counting**: `gaussSum_eq_of_arf_eq` + the landed Arf pins (`prop_6_9_unramified`, `lemma_6_8` cl. 4) convert the form identification straight into the ∓2^m value.

**The design** ([docs/p16d6e4aA-gammaA-gauss-design.md](../gq2-lean/docs/p16d6e4aA-gammaA-gauss-design.md)): Route W (word-relator evaluation, everything Γ_A-native and banked) over Route K (the paper's §6.3–6.5 Kummer ledger, which is AbsGalQ2-side in this repo), with four bricks — **A-1** coordinates (extract e6's inlined Stage-0 as reusable declarations), **A-2** the F-brick (package the H²↪𝔽₂ device as a computation rule `iotaB φ = relatorValue φ`), **A-3** the relator-expansion quadratic, **A-4** the form identification + count (mirrors `GaussZFinal` verbatim). One standing watch-item carried forward: re-read the paper's (83)/pp. 40–41 before freezing A-4's un/ram identification.

**Where the whole P-16 arc now stands:** `prop_8_9` proved (std-3 + {B6, B7}); the cascade closed; `hGaussZF` discharged at both pinned values; `hGaussZA` is the one remaining ledger hypothesis, and P-16d6e4aA is the open, fully-scoped ticket that eliminates it. ## A-2 is landed — and the "F-brick" turned out to be nearly free

**[GQ2/IotaGammaA.lean](../gq2-lean/GQ2/IotaGammaA.lean)** (commit `c3e8b3a`, registered, library green at 8741 jobs, guard all-pass, **all four theorems `#print axioms` = std-3 exactly**).

The pleasant surprise from the survey: the device I expected to have to build — packaging `card_H2_gammaA_le_two`'s injection as a computation rule — **already exists in full** in WordCoh2's CardBound section. P-16c4 didn't just prove the cardinality bound; it built an additive obstruction homomorphism `obs : Z²(Γ_A, 𝔽₂) →+ 𝔽₂` (the sum of the tame and wild relator values at a finite admissible level, well-defined by `obs_congr`) together with the exact kernel identification **`obs_ker_eq_B2`**. So A-2 collapsed to four glue theorems:

- `iotaB_eq_obs` — the coboundary indicator `ι_{Γ_A}` *equals* the word-relator obstruction: two 𝔽₂-values with the same vanishing locus (`iotaB_eq_zero_iff` vs `obs_ker_eq_B2`), closed by `decide`.
- `iotaB_eq_levelFactor_obs` — the evaluation form: compute at *any* finite-admissible-level factorization of the `(1,1)`-normalization.
- `QZero_eq_obs` / **`QZero_eq_levelFactor_obs`** — the A-3 interface: for any V-cocycle `c` over Γ_A,
  `Q⁰(c) = relZPair(tame).1 + relZPair(wild).2` at any `LevelFactor` of the normalized graph pullback. (`graphPullback_mem_Z2_of_cocycle` turned out to be generic-Γ already — KeystoneDelta:1516.)

This means the remaining A-3 brick is sharper than the design estimated: build one explicit `LevelFactor` for `graphPullback (En.dat l h) ρ'₀ c` — both `ρ'₀` and `c` factor through finite levels, and `exists_twoCocycle_factor` is the generic factoring device — then expand the two `relZPair` relator values along the relator words in e6's generator coordinates. That expansion is where the paper's (83) quadratic appears, feeding A-4's `q̄`/`qDouble` identification.

Four Lean gotchas banked on the board row for whoever continues (GA's namespace, `include htriv`, the `obs` name clash, the metavar-under-coercion splice).

**Lane status:** A-2 ☑ · A-1 open (independent, mechanical — extract e6's Stage-0 coordinates) · A-3 next in the critical path (now consumes A-2's `QZero_eq_levelFactor_obs`) · A-4 gated on A-3. A-1 and A-3 are write-disjoint, so they can run as parallel agents if you want to keep the swarm on it.

## A-3 is landed — `Q⁰` over Γ_A is now a concrete relator value, std-3 exactly

**[GQ2/GaussZRelatorGammaA.lean](../gq2-lean/GQ2/GaussZRelatorGammaA.lean)** (297 lines, commit `0a607d6`, registered, library green at 8743 jobs, guard all-pass, `kappa0Cocycle` and the keystone both **std-3 exactly**).

The route improved substantially during the survey. I had planned raw fiber-telescopes along the relator words, but the wild relator's `ω₂` limit-powers would have made that heavy — and the repo's own evaluation idiom (the `Psi`-pattern in `obs_coboundary_eq`) pointed at something better. The decisive observation: **`graphPullback dat ρ'₀ c.c` is the pullback of the base central cocycle `κ⁰` on `V ⋊ C` along the graph homomorphism, on the nose** — `graphPullback_eq_kappa0_graph` is literally `rfl`, and the graph *is* a homomorphism precisely because `c` is a crossed cocycle. So the keystone reads:

> **`QZero DD ρM c = relZPair (gammaGen.map (graphSdHom c)) (kappa0Cocycle DD.dat hdat) |₁ + |₂`**

— the tame and wild relator values in the *concrete finite extension* `CentExt κ⁰`, evaluated at the four explicit generator pairs `(c(gᵢ), ρ'₀(gᵢ))`. No level choice, no ω₂-telescope: the proof builds the kernel-level `LevelFactor`, transports through A-2's `QZero_eq_levelFactor_obs` and the banked `relZPair_comap`, and the final marking identification closes by `rfl` (`QuotientGroup.lift` computes at `mk`). This is exactly the formal face of the paper's Prop 6.5/(82)–(83) base-contribution ledger.

Supporting pieces landed with it: the isolated semidirect group `Sd C V` (no `Prod`-instance pollution), `kappa0Cocycle` (Lemma 6.1's associativity from the `IsEquivariantFactorSet` clauses, closed by a char-2 `linear_combination`), `IsEquivariantFactorSet.m_zero`, `graphSdHom`, and `continuous_vcocycle_c`.

**Meanwhile the A-1 agent finished too** (`07c5ba9` + `0d97243`): `h1CoordGammaA`, σ-free `finite_vcocycle_gammaA`, an **hfaith-free `hfix_of_simple_nt`** (important — faithfulness isn't block-derivable), and — big one — **the paper-reread watch-item is resolved**: `docs/p16d6e4aA-a4-prep.md` freezes the un/ram identification (`Q⁰_A = q̄` unramified, the Wall double `qDouble q̄ U` ramified, orientation-free; the candidate zero-counts equal the local (115) values).
